src: Say it at the end. Polite: 재밌었어요.
tgt: Ucapkan di akhir acara. Sopan: 재밌었어요.

src: 담에 = 다음에. 보자 = let's see (each other).
tgt: 담에 = 다음에. 보자 = yuk, bertemu (harfiah 'mari saling melihat').

src: 최애가 누구예요? = who's your bias? 차애 = second favorite.
tgt: 최애가 누구예요? = bias-mu siapa? 차애 = favorit kedua.

src: From 오타쿠. 덕질해요 = I'm into fandom stuff.
tgt: Dari 오타쿠 (otaku). 덕질해요 = saya aktif di fandom.

src: 입덕 = entering the fandom. 탈덕 = leaving it.
tgt: 입덕 = masuk fandom. 탈덕 = keluar dari fandom.

src: Every new album is a 컴백. 컴백 언제예요?
tgt: Setiap album baru disebut 컴백. 컴백 언제예요? = comeback-nya kapan?

src: 무대 진짜 잘해요 = they perform really well.
tgt: 무대 진짜 잘해요 = penampilan panggung mereka bagus sekali.

src: 콘서트 티켓팅 = ticketing, a blood sport.
tgt: 콘서트 티켓팅 = berburu tiket konser, alias war tiket.

src: Each group has one. 응원 = cheering.
tgt: Setiap grup punya lightstick sendiri. 응원 = dukungan, sorakan.

src: 떼 = flock. The crowd sings the whole song.
tgt: 떼 = kawanan. Penonton menyanyikan seluruh lagu.

src: 저 팬이에요 = I'm a fan (of you / them).
tgt: 저 팬이에요 = saya penggemarmu (atau penggemar mereka).

src: 이 노래 진짜 좋아요 = this song is so good.
tgt: 이 노래 진짜 좋아요 = lagu ini bagus sekali.

src: 안무 외웠어요 = I memorized the choreo.
tgt: 안무 외웠어요 = saya sudah hafal koreonya.

src: 몇 년에 데뷔했어요? = what year did they debut?
tgt: 몇 년에 데뷔했어요? = debut tahun berapa?
직접 + 캠. Video konser yang fokus pada satu member.

src: 스토리 봤어? = did you see my story?
맞팔 = follow back. 맞팔해요 = let's follow each other.
tgt: 맞팔 = saling follow (folbek). 맞팔해요 = mari saling follow.

src: 짤 보내 줘 = send me the meme.
tgt: 짤 보내 줘 = tolong kirim meme-nya, ya.

src: 갑자기 분위기 싸해짐. When a joke dies.
tgt: 갑자기 분위기 싸해짐. Saat lelucon jadi garing.

src: Used for cute oversharing, not gross stuff.
tgt: Untuk berbagi hal kecil yang lucu, bukan hal yang menjijikkan.

src: 꾸민 듯 안 꾸민 듯. The 'I woke up like this' look.
tgt: 꾸민 듯 안 꾸민 듯: seperti dandan, seperti tidak. Gaya 'bangun tidur langsung begini'.

src: Very casual slang with a vulgar origin: only with close friends. JMT in texts.
tgt: Slang sangat santai yang asalnya kasar: hanya dengan teman dekat. Di chat: JMT.

src: 핵 = nuke prefix. 아싸 = outsider / introvert.
tgt: 핵 = awalan 'nuklir', sebagai penguat. 아싸 = orang yang menyendiri, introver.

src: 소소하지만 확실한 행복. Café, nap, rain.
tgt: 소소하지만 확실한 행복. Kafe, tidur siang, hujan.

src: 열심히 공부. 열공 중 = studying hard right now.
tgt: 열심히 공부. 열공 중 = sedang belajar giat.

src: 멘탈 붕괴. 멘붕 왔어 = I'm losing it.
tgt: 멘탈 붕괴. 멘붕 왔어 = aku udah nggak kuat.

src: 사이 = relationship between people. The DTR line.
tgt: 사이 = hubungan antara dua orang. Pertanyaan untuk memperjelas status.

src: 다정하다 = affectionate, kind. Compliment beyond looks.
tgt: 다정하다 = penuh kasih, perhatian. Pujian di luar penampilan.

src: 편하다 = comfortable. High praise in Korean dating.
tgt: 편하다 = nyaman. Pujian besar dalam pacaran ala Korea.

src: 잘못하다 = to do wrong. Own it.
풀다 = to untie / release. 화 풀어 줘 softer.
tgt: 풀다 = melepas ikatan. 화 풀어 줘 lebih lembut.
Pasangan merayakan hari ke-100. Ini acara besar.

src: 잡다 = to hold. 아/어도 돼 = may I.
안다 = to hug. 안아 줄게 = I'll hug you.
tgt: 안다 = memeluk. 안아 줄게 = sini, aku peluk, ya.
죽겠어 = 'rasanya mau mati', sebagai penguat. Santai dan dramatis.

src: I have something to tell you
tgt: Ada yang ingin aku bicarakan denganmu

src: Sets up a serious talk. 한테 = to (person).
I think we're a good match
마감 = deadline. 마감 지켰어요 = I made the deadline.
tgt: 마감 = tenggat (deadline). 마감 지켰어요 = saya berhasil memenuhi tenggat.

src: I'll check and get back to you
tgt: Akan saya cek dulu, nanti saya kabari

src: Formal. The email reply you'll send most.
tgt: Formal. Balasan email yang paling sering akan kamu kirim.

src: To a colleague or senior. 잠깐 = briefly.
tgt: Kepada rekan kerja atau atasan. 잠깐 = sebentar.

src: Could you help me with this?
tgt: Bisakah Anda membantu saya dengan ini?

src: 도와주시다 honorific + 수 있어요 = could you.
tgt: 도와주시다 bentuk hormat + 수 있어요 = bisakah Anda.

src: 퇴근 = leaving work. Say it to the room, always.
tgt: 퇴근 = pulang kerja. Ucapkan ke seisi ruangan, selalu.

src: To seniors when leaving. 수고하세요 to those still working.
tgt: Kepada atasan saat pulang. 수고하세요 untuk orang yang masih bekerja.

src: 회식 = company dinner. Attendance is… encouraged.
tgt: 회식 = makan malam kantor. Hadir itu… 'dianjurkan'.

src: What should we have for lunch?
야근 = night work. 아/어야 돼요 = have to.
tgt: 야근 = kerja malam. 아/어야 돼요 = harus.

src: Looking forward to working with you
_note: 잘 부탁드립니다 is glossed Mohon bantuannya elsewhere; profile id-ko §3.7 allows Mohon kerja samanya on this work-email card.

src: Closes work emails and first meetings.
tgt: Penutup email kerja dan pertemuan pertama. Di luar kantor: Mohon bantuannya.

src: Standard greeting for someone you haven't seen in a while.
tgt: Salam biasa untuk orang yang sudah lama tidak kamu temui.

src: Add 덕분에 (thanks to you) to sound extra polite.
tgt: Tambahkan 덕분에 (berkat kamu) supaya terdengar lebih sopan.

src: 요즘 = these days. 어때요 = how is it.
Lit. 'it's just like that'. Very common honest answer.
tgt: Harfiah: 'ya begitu saja'. Jawaban jujur yang sangat umum.

src: 네요 ending = noticing something out loud. 날씨가 춥네요 = it's cold, huh.
tgt: Akhiran 네요 = mengomentari sesuatu yang baru disadari. 날씨가 춥네요 = dingin, ya.

src: What are you doing this weekend?

tgt: Lebih lembut daripada 진짜요?. Keduanya boleh.

src: 또 = again. 내일 봐요 = see you tomorrow.
tgt: 또 = lagi. 내일 봐요 = sampai jumpa besok.

src: 가세요 = go well. Say it when THEY are leaving.
tgt: Harfiah 'pergilah dengan tenang' (가세요 = pergi, bentuk hormat). Ucapkan saat DIA yang pergi.

src: 계세요 = stay well. Say it when YOU are leaving.
tgt: Harfiah 'tinggallah dengan tenang' (계세요 = tinggal, bentuk hormat). Ucapkan saat KAMU yang pergi.
ㄹ게요 = janji: 'nanti saya …, ya'. 연락 = kabar, kontak.

src: 소고기 beef, 돼지고기 pork, 닭고기 chicken.
tgt: 소고기 sapi, 돼지고기 babi, 닭고기 ayam.

src: Or just raise a hand and say 저기요 (excuse me).
tgt: Atau angkat tangan dan bilang 저기요 (permisi).

src: 맵다 = spicy. 안 매워요? = is it not spicy?
tgt: 맵다 = pedas. 안 매워요? = tidak pedas?

src: Say it to the owner on the way out.
tgt: Ucapkan ke pemilik saat kamu keluar.

src: 잔 = cup counter. 두 잔 = two cups.
tgt: 잔 = kata penggolong untuk cangkir atau gelas. 두 잔 = dua cangkir.

src: You usually pay at the counter.
Clink glasses; pour for others, not yourself.
tgt: Benturkan gelas; tuangkan untuk orang lain, bukan untuk diri sendiri.

src: Lit. 'I ate well.' Pairs with 잘 먹겠습니다.
tgt: Harfiah: 'Saya sudah makan dengan baik.' Pasangan dari 잘 먹겠습니다.

src: Seoul Metro is the easiest way around.
tgt: Seperti MRT: Seoul Metro adalah cara paling mudah untuk berkeliling.

src: Tell the driver: ~로 가 주세요 (please go to ~).
tgt: Bilang ke sopir: ~로 가 주세요 (tolong ke ~).
Kalimat di taksi. Ucapkan lengkap dan sopan, bukan sekadar 'Kiri!'.

src: Tap-in transit card. Buy at any convenience store.
tgt: Kartu transportasi yang di-tap, seperti kartu uang elektronik. Bisa dibeli di minimarket mana pun.

src: Add the place + 에: 명동에 어떻게 가요?
tgt: Tambahkan tempat + 에: 명동에 어떻게 가요?

src: 오늘 뭐 해요? = what are you doing today?
tgt: 오늘 뭐 해요? = hari ini ada rencana apa?

src: 어제 뭐 했어요? = what did you do yesterday?
tgt: 어제 뭐 했어요? = apa yang kamu lakukan kemarin?

src: 지금 몇 시예요? = what time is it now?
tgt: 지금 몇 시예요? = sekarang jam berapa?
Juga berarti sarapan / makan siang / makan malam.
불금 = 'Jumat membara', Jumat malam untuk bersenang-senang.

src: 언제 와요? = when are you coming?
매일 공부해요 = I study every day.
tgt: 매일 공부해요 = saya belajar setiap hari.

src: Low-key way to ask someone out.
tgt: Cara halus untuk mengajak seseorang kencan.
어머니 / 아버지 = versi yang lebih formal.

src: 형 if you're male, 오빠 if you're female. Also used for older male friends.
tgt: 형 kalau kamu laki-laki, 오빠 kalau kamu perempuan. Juga dipakai untuk teman laki-laki yang lebih tua.

src: 누나 if you're male, 언니 if you're female.
tgt: 누나 kalau kamu laki-laki, 언니 kalau kamu perempuan.

src: 남동생 = younger brother, 여동생 = younger sister.
tgt: 남동생 = adik laki-laki, 여동생 = adik perempuan.

src: Also polite for any elderly person.
tgt: Juga sapaan sopan untuk orang lanjut usia mana pun.

src: 가족이 몇 명이에요? = how many in your family?
tgt: 가족이 몇 명이에요? = keluargamu berapa orang?
Sebenarnya hanya untuk teman yang seumur.

src: 한국 사람 = Korean person. 미국 사람 = American.
tgt: 한국 사람 = orang Korea. 미국 사람 = orang Amerika.
기분이 나빠요 = suasana hati saya buruk.
요즘 바빠요 = belakangan ini saya sibuk.

src: Also 진짜로. 정말? (jeongmal) is slightly softer.
tgt: Bisa juga 진짜로. 정말? (jeongmal) sedikit lebih lembut.

src: Good or bad surprise. 대박 사건 = huge deal.
tgt: Untuk kejutan baik atau buruk. 대박 사건 = kejadian besar.

src: Stunned reaction. Mostly texting and casual speech.
tgt: Reaksi terperangah. Kebanyakan di chat dan obrolan santai.

src: Sigh word for any small misfortune.
tgt: Keluhan untuk kesialan kecil apa pun.

src: Casual. Said while clearly not okay.
tgt: Santai. Sering diucapkan saat jelas-jelas sedang tidak baik-baik saja.

src: What do I do / oh no

tgt: Dari kata Inggris 'fighting'. Seruan dukungan sebelum menghadapi hal yang berat.
Santai. Untuk 'Maaf, apa?' yang sopan, pakai 네? (ne?).

src: Hello, nice to meet you for the first time. / Hi! Nice to meet you.
tgt: Halo, salam kenal. / Ya, halo! Senang bertemu dengan Anda.

src: Thank you for helping. / Not at all.
tgt: Terima kasih atas bantuan Anda. / Ah, bukan apa-apa.

src: Sorry I'm late. / It's fine, I just got here too.
tgt: Mohon maaf, saya terlambat. / Tidak apa-apa, saya juga baru datang.

src: Excuse me, where's the bathroom? / Go straight that way.
tgt: Permisi, toiletnya di mana? / Jalan lurus saja ke arah sana.

src: What can I get you? / This one, to go.
tgt: Mau pesan apa? / Minta yang ini. Dibungkus, ya.

src: Are you okay? Hurt? / Yes, I'm fine.
tgt: Tidak apa-apa? Ada yang terluka? / Ya, saya tidak apa-apa.

src: Sorry, please speak slowly. / Ah, sure, I'll slow down.
tgt: Maaf, tolong bicara pelan-pelan. / Ah, baik. Saya bicara pelan-pelan, ya.

src: Your Korean is good! / No, I'm still not good.
tgt: Bahasa Korea Anda bagus sekali! / Ah, tidak, saya masih belum lancar.

src: Excuse me, coming through. / Go ahead.
tgt: Permisi, saya mau lewat. / Ya, silakan.

src: Excuse me! The menu, please. / Yes, one moment.
tgt: Permisi! Minta menunya, ya. / Ya, sebentar.

src: Excuse me, please help me. / Sure, what do you need?
tgt: Permisi, tolong bantu saya. / Ya, ada yang bisa dibantu?

src: Sorry, say that again please. / The subway station is on the left.
tgt: Maaf, tolong ulangi. / Stasiun kereta bawah tanahnya di sebelah kiri.

src: Can you speak English? / A little. I'll speak slowly.
tgt: Bisa bahasa Inggris? / Sedikit. Saya bicara pelan-pelan, ya.

src: What is this? / Tteokbokki. It's a bit spicy.
Do you take cards? / Yes. Insert it here.
tgt: Bisa pakai kartu? / Ya, bisa. Tolong masukkan di sini.

src: What's the wifi password? / It's on the receipt.
tgt: Kata sandi wifi-nya apa? / Ada di struk.

src: I'm lost. Where is this? / This is Hongdae. Where are you going?
tgt: Saya tersesat. Ini di mana? / Ini Hongdae. Mau ke mana?

src: What's your name? / I'm Kii. What's yours?
tgt: Siapa namamu? / Saya Kii. Siapa namamu?

src: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you too.
tgt: Senang bertemu denganmu. / Saya juga senang bertemu.

src: Where are you from? / From the US. Oklahoma.
tgt: Asalmu dari mana? / Dari Amerika Serikat. Oklahoma.

src: Excuse me, how old are you? / 28. And you?
tgt: Maaf, boleh tahu umur Anda? / 28. Kalau Anda?

src: What do you do? / I work at an IT company.
tgt: Kerja apa? / Saya bekerja di perusahaan IT.

src: Do you study Korean? / Yes, a little every day.
tgt: Kamu belajar bahasa Korea? / Ya, sedikit-sedikit setiap hari.

src: What's your hobby? / Running and music.
Long time no see! How've you been? / Good, thanks. You?
tgt: Lama tidak bertemu! Apa kabar selama ini? / Baik, berkat kamu. Kamu apa kabar selama ini?

src: How are things lately? / Busy. But fun.
tgt: Bagaimana kabarmu belakangan ini? / Sibuk. Tapi seru.

src: Nice weather today. / Yes, perfect for a walk.
tgt: Hari ini cuacanya bagus, ya. / Ya, pas sekali untuk jalan-jalan.

src: What are you doing this weekend? / Going hiking. Want to come?
tgt: Apa rencanamu akhir pekan ini? / Saya mau mendaki gunung. Mau ikut?

src: Today was fun. See you again! / Yes, I'll be in touch.
tgt: Hari ini seru. Sampai jumpa lagi! / Ya, nanti saya hubungi, ya.

src: I'll head out first. Goodbye (stay well). / Bye (go well).
tgt: Saya pergi duluan, ya. Selamat tinggal. / Ya, selamat jalan.

src: I'm bored. Let's hang out! / Deal! Where should we meet?
tgt: Aku bosan. Yuk, main! / Siap! Mau bertemu di mana?

src: Are you free tomorrow? / In the afternoon. Why?
tgt: Besok ada waktu? / Ada, sore. Kenapa?

src: I'm going to a café, wanna come? / Sure, let's go.
tgt: Aku mau ke kafe, mau ikut? / Boleh, yuk!

src: I'm hungry. Wanna go eat? / Yes! What should we eat?
tgt: Lapar. Mau pergi makan? / Iya! Kita makan apa?

src: When should we meet? / How about Saturday?
tgt: Kita kapan bertemu? / Gimana kalau Sabtu?

src: Where should we meet? / Let's meet at Gangnam station exit 11.
tgt: Mau bertemu di mana? / Yuk, bertemu di pintu keluar 11 Stasiun Gangnam.

src: Where are you? Almost here? / Sorry, coming now. 5 minutes!
tgt: Di mana? Udah dekat? / Maaf, aku jalan sekarang. 5 menit!

src: Today was really fun. / Me too. Let's hang out again!
tgt: Hari ini seru sekali. / Aku juga. Yuk, main lagi!

src: Ready to order? / One iced Americano, please.
tgt: Sudah siap memesan? / Minta satu iced americano.

src: What sizes do you have? / Tall, grande, venti.
tgt: Ada ukuran apa saja? / Ada tall, grande, venti.

src: Do you have a points card? / No, that's okay.
tgt: Mau kumpulkan poin? / Tidak, tidak usah.
_note: 괜찮아요 here is a polite refusal ('no, thanks'): Indonesian says Tidak usah, not the fixed Tidak apa-apa.

src: Please heat this up. / Sure, it takes a minute.
tgt: Tolong panaskan ini. / Baik, perlu satu menit.

src: Do you need a bag? / Yes, one please.

tgt: Tunai atau kartu? / Pakai kartu, ya.

src: Where is a pharmacy? / On the first floor of that building.
tgt: Apotek di mana? / Ada di lantai 1 gedung itu.

src: Where does it hurt? / My head hurts. I have a fever too.
tgt: Sakitnya di mana? / Kepala saya sakit. Saya juga demam.

src: Do you have painkillers? / Yes, take these after a meal.
tgt: Ada obat pereda nyeri? / Ada, silakan minum ini sesudah makan.

src: Do you have allergies? / Yes, I'm allergic to peanuts.
tgt: Ada alergi? / Ya, saya alergi kacang tanah.

src: How many times a day? / Three times, 30 minutes after meals.
tgt: Sehari diminum berapa kali? / Tiga kali sehari, 30 menit sesudah makan.

src: Package! / Please leave it at the door.
tgt: Paket! / Ya, tolong taruh di depan pintu.

src: How much is rent? / 500,000 won, maintenance included.
tgt: Sewa bulanannya berapa? / 500.000 won. Sudah termasuk biaya pengelolaan.

src: Can you dry clean this? / Yes, pick it up tomorrow afternoon.
tgt: Ini bisa di-dry clean? / Bisa, silakan ambil besok sore.

src: I'm starting work with you today. Please take care of me. / Likewise.
tgt: Mulai hari ini kita bekerja bersama. Mohon bantuannya. / Ya, saya juga mohon bantuannya.

src: How are things? / So-so. Just busy.
tgt: Bagaimana kabarmu belakangan ini? / Biasa saja. Sibuk terus.

src: I'm a coffee addict. / Me too! At least three cups a day.
tgt: Saya kecanduan kopi. / Saya juga! Sehari minimal tiga cangkir.

src: I'm going to Korea next month. / Really? Where to?
tgt: Bulan depan saya ke Korea. / Sungguh? Ke mana?

src: I should get going. Goodbye. / Okay, get home safe.
tgt: Saya pamit dulu, ya. Selamat tinggal. / Ya, hati-hati di jalan.

src: See you next time. / Yes, I'll be in touch!
tgt: Sampai jumpa lagi lain kali. / Ya, nanti saya hubungi, ya!

src: Hey, what are you doing? / Watching Netflix at home. Why?
tgt: Hei, kamu sedang apa? / Nonton Netflix di rumah. Kenapa?

src: Are you free tonight? / Yeah, after seven.
tgt: Nanti malam ada waktu? / Iya, setelah jam tujuh.

src: Wanna come over? I'll order chicken. / Deal! I'll bring beer.
tgt: Mau main ke rumahku? Aku pesan ayam goreng, ya. / Siap! Aku bawa bir, ya.

src: Today was so fun. Let's hang again. / Sure, see you next week!
tgt: Hari ini seru sekali. Yuk, main lagi! / Oke, sampai jumpa minggu depan!

src: Can I get your number? / Sure, 010-3322-7788.
Do you have Instagram? / Yes, I'll give you my handle.
tgt: Punya Instagram? / Ya, nanti saya kasih tahu ID saya, ya.

src: Today was lovely. Shall we meet again? / Sure. This time it's on me.
tgt: Hari ini menyenangkan. Gimana kalau kita bertemu lagi? / Oke. Kali ini aku yang traktir, ya.

src: It's late. I'll walk you home. / It's fine, I can take the subway.
tgt: Sudah malam. Aku antar, ya. / Nggak apa-apa, aku naik kereta aja.

src: You look pretty today. / Thanks. I got a haircut.
tgt: Hari ini kamu cantik, ya. / Terima kasih. Saya potong rambut.

src: You're here! I missed you. / Me too. Did you wait long?
tgt: Sudah datang? Saya kangen. / Saya juga. Lama menunggu?

src: Did you get home safe? / Yeah, just got in. Thanks for today.
tgt: Udah sampai rumah dengan selamat? / Iya, baru sampai. Makasih untuk hari ini.

src: I'm going to sleep. Night! / Okay, sweet dreams.
tgt: Aku tidur dulu, ya. Selamat tidur! / Iya, mimpi indah, ya.

src: Did you eat? / Not yet. Wanna eat together?
tgt: Udah makan? / Belum. Mau makan bersama?

src: What are you up to? / Just lying around. Bored.
tgt: Kamu sedang apa? / Cuma rebahan. Bosan.

src: Where are you? Almost here? / Sorry, five minutes! Just got off the subway.
